title: How Far a Granite Ridge Instalment Schedule Has Run and the Share of the Credit Pot Drawn
content:
What a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass account shows of its instalment schedule reduces the share of the credit pot drawn in one application.

Where the pass account shows no scheduled instalment presented and none refused, three quarters of the pot is drawn, a share of 75 per cent, and the rest stays on the pass record for the instalments still to fall. Where the pass account shows at least one scheduled instalment cleared and no refusal standing, nine tenths of the pot is drawn, a share of 90 per cent. In any other case the share drawn is not reduced by this rule.

A refusal standing on the pass account closes both cases: neither the opening position nor the running position is reached while any refusal stands, whatever the instalments already cleared show. An account showing no instalment cleared and a refusal standing therefore falls outside both, as does an account showing instalments cleared and a refusal standing.

Worked on a hypothetical account: a pot of 400.00 on a pass account whose plan has been opened but which shows no scheduled instalment presented and no refusal. Three quarters of the pot is drawn, which is 300.00, and 100.00 stays on the pass record for the instalments still to fall. On the same pot, an account showing two scheduled instalments cleared and no refusal gives nine tenths of 400.00, which is 360.00.
